name: Stanimir's Plum Wine

source.note: The Tser Pool camp's plum wine, the cask Stanimir bets at his fire; ours.

summary: A small cask of the Tser Pool camp's plum wine, sweet as a promise and about as strong as a threat.
text: Stanimir's own, from the cask he bets at his fire. It tastes of plums and smoke and gets better with company.
